name: Maine
summary: The state coat of arms on blue: a farmer and a sailor flanking a shield with a moose under a pine tree, beneath the North Star and the motto 'Dirigo' (I lead). In 2024 voters rejected restoring the simpler 1901 pine tree flag.
origin: Maine's first state flag (1901–1909) was a buff field with a green pine tree and a blue star. It was replaced in 1909 by the coat-of-arms design. A 2024 referendum to restore the 1901 flag was rejected by voters.

colors.name: Blue
colors.meaning: The field, matching the US flag.

symbols.name: Farmer and sailor
symbols.description: A farmer with a scythe and a sailor with an anchor.
symbols.meaning: Agriculture and seafaring, Maine's traditional industries.

symbols.name: Moose and pine
symbols.description: A moose under a white pine on the shield.
symbols.meaning: Maine's forests and wildlife; the 'Pine Tree State'.

symbols.name: North Star and 'Dirigo'
symbols.description: A star above the shield and the motto 'I lead'.
symbols.meaning: Maine as the northernmost state at the time of its admission.

history.label: Pine tree flag
history.note: Buff with a pine and a star.

facts: The 1901 pine tree flag became popular again in the 2010s on merchandise.
Voters rejected switching to it in November 2024.
clues: A coat of arms on blue with a farmer, a sailor, a moose and a pine tree.
Voters chose to keep it over a simpler pine tree design in 2024.
